description: Defines classes and structures for managing uplink PDU repositories in a 5G NR PHY layer implementation, including interfaces for adding PDUs, managing repository scope, and retrieving resource grids.

classes.name: uplink_pdu_slot_repository
classes.description: Interface for registering PUSCH, PUCCH, and SRS PDUs within a slot.

classes.name: unique_uplink_pdu_slot_repository
classes.description: Manages a scoped, unique instance of an uplink PDU slot repository, ensuring proper resource handling.

classes.name: uplink_pdu_slot_repository_callback
classes.description: Callback interface extending uplink_pdu_slot_repository, adding method to finish adding PDUs and retrieve resource grid.

classes.name: uplink_pdu_slot_repository_pool
classes.description: Abstract pool interface to obtain uplink PDU slot repositories for specific slots.

methods.name: add_pusch_pdu
methods.description: Adds a PUSCH PDU to the repository.

methods.name: add_pucch_pdu
methods.description: Adds a PUCCH PDU to the repository.

methods.name: add_srs_pdu
methods.description: Adds an SRS PDU to the repository.

methods.name: finish_adding_pdus
methods.description: Signals completion of PDU addition and returns the resource grid.

methods.name: get_pdu_slot_repository
methods.description: Retrieves the PDU slot repository for a given slot.
